one: A panorama of foundation models: models/algorithms, systems/infrastructure, ethics/social impact, plus a hands-on project.
pos: CS 324 is a foundation-model course launched in 2023, covering the principles, systems, and social impact of models such as GPT-3, CLIP, and Stable Diffusion. It has industry speakers and emphasizes projects over derivations; it suits people who want a fast, broad view of FMs.
topics: **Ethics and social impact**: bias, copyright, misuse, regulation
**Quarter-long project**: study FM capabilities or build an application
assess: Mainly a quarter-long final project, possibly with assignments/reading. Check the current syllabus for details.
who: Product/research/strategy people who want to understand the FM ecosystem; students looking for FM application directions.
tips: The content leans 2023; combine it with recent papers. Pick a narrow, deep problem for the project.
note: Not offered in the 2026–27 ExploreCourses listing; the link points to the 2023 winter course materials.
